chain.label: Latent manufacturing defect in speedbrake no-back clutch
chain.trigger: a latent assembly defect in the no-back clutch mechanism...one of the four speedbrake lever braking pins was improperly secured, which allowed it to intermittently rotate within its assembly and prevented the no-back clutch from transmitting the torque

chain.label: Automatic speedbrakes failed to deploy after touchdown
chain.trigger: the automatic speedbrakes failed to automatically deploy as designed after touchdown

caused_by.evidence: a manufacturing defect in the incident airplane's speedbrake no-back clutch mechanism prevented the speedbrakes from automatically deploying during the incident landing

chain.label: Thrust reversers locked in transit, did not deploy on initial command
chain.trigger: the precise timing of the unloading of the main landing gear...coincided with the deployment of the thrust reversers resulted in a rare mechanical/hydraulic interaction in the thrust reverser system, and the thrust reversers were locked in transit instead of continuing to deploy

chain.label: Captain made erroneous deployment callouts and both pilots fixated on resolving the thrust reverser problem
chain.trigger: the captain stated, 'deployed'...and then...'two in reverse'...the captain's callouts were erroneous, as neither system had deployed

caused_by.evidence: the captain's erroneous speedbrakes 'deployed' callout was likely made in anticipation (not in confirmation) of speedbrake deployment after he observed the speedbrake handle's initial movement
it is likely that the captain made the callout because he expected normal thrust reverser deployment after seeing the amber EICAS annunciation

chain.label: Captain took over thrust reverser controls from the first officer
chain.trigger: the captain was taking command of the thrust reverser levers...the captain deviated from normal company procedures regarding the pilot flying/pilot monitoring responsibilities during the landing roll

caused_by.evidence: about 0.8 second after the first officer stated 'no reverse,' the captain was taking command of the thrust reverser levers

chain.label: Captain failed to monitor and manually extend the speedbrakes
chain.trigger: neither pilot recognized that the speedbrakes had not automatically deployed (as selected) because they were both distracted by, confused by, and trying to resolve the thrust reverser nondeployment

caused_by.evidence: if the captain had adhered to his monitoring responsibilities during the landing roll, it is more likely that he would have recognized that the speedbrakes had not automatically deployed and corrected the situation by manually deploying them

chain.label: Airplane ran off the departure end of the runway into deep snow
chain.trigger: the airplane continued off the departure end of the runway, coming to a stop in deep snow off the end of the paved surface

caused_by.evidence: without speedbrakes deployed after touchdown, braking effectiveness may be reduced initially by as much as 60 percent
the thrust reversers did not begin to redeploy until about 18 seconds after touchdown

if either pilot had observed that the speedbrakes had not automatically deployed and subsequently corrected the situation by manually deploying them, the airplane's stopping distance would have been greatly decreased
